dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shouldn't you be at work right now?

dialogues.speaker: Yikuo
dialogues.text: How dare you. I'm taking a brief moment of much-needed respite from a very hectic schedule, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Yikuo
dialogues.text: Hardly my fault if you didn't see me while I was hard at work just now, is it?
